Maya: Spinning up RC for small perf optimization on the tokenizer path. RC id: rc-fraser-5823. Will hold a 20m quiet window. Need one QA + RM ack.

deploy-bot: RC created: rc-fraser-5823 | image: registry.redwood/serve:sha256:ffee3344 | pinned=true | To start staged rollout: `/deploy promote rc-fraser-5823 --to=canary --traffic=5%`.

Leo: Acknowledged. Kicking off targeted unit smoke and the regression harness (fast). Expected ~8m.

Anika: Running regression harness now. I will post failures inline.

Theo: Infra prechecks: node quotas ok, GPU pool capacity reserved, KV warm cron scheduled for +2m after canary start.

Anika: regression: 0 fails on 200 testcases. Sample latencies look slightly lower median. Log snippet: `OK: tokenizer init 12ms -> 9ms`

Maya: Good. Plan: start 5% canary, watch for 10m, if stable move to 25% over 15m. Abort triggers: p99 increase > 200ms absolute OR error spikes >1% 5m rolling.

Leo: Putting the rollback snippet here for visibility and automation playbook:
```bash
# revert to last promoted
/deploy rollback promo-5823001 --to=stable
# unpin image
/gcr unpin registry.redwood/serve:sha256:ffee3344
# remove kv prefetch flag (if set)
/k8s patch ds tokenizer --remove-prefetch
```

deploy-bot: Queued action: `/deploy start rc-fraser-5823 --traffic=5% --kv-warm=delayed`

OncallBot: Quiet window engaged for 20m. Alert noise will be suppressed per policy but critical alerts still escalate.

Maya: RM conditional signoff: will approve staged promotion if 25% is stable for 15m and synthetic evals show no degradation in quality metrics.

deploy-bot: Promotion kicked: promo-5823001 | 5% -> target 25% staged. Monitor: `/deploy status promo-5823001`

Theo: Observability: all green so far. Retention probes show stable CPU and mem. Dash: https://dashboards.internal/rc/5823

Anika: 12m update: 5% canary stable. Running longer evals next 10m.

Leo: Triggering ramp to 25% (staircase over 15m) now: `/deploy promote rc-fraser-5823 --to=prod --staged "25%:15m" --note "tokenizer perf"`

deploy-bot: Promotion started -> promo-5823001 updated. Expected end timestamp 5823457805.

Anika: 30m status: post-ramp 25% stable. No error increase. Quality checks pass on sampled outputs.

Maya: Final: RM approves full lift next maintenance window. I'll add release notes: "Tokenization micro-optimizations; median latency down ~10%; KV prefetch enabled for warm paths." Include rollback snippet above in release notes under 'ops playbook'.

Theo: Will schedule final full-lift in next 2-hour change window. Marking this RC as ready. :rocket:
